answer: Use graph conductance, not key age. At each reward settlement, build a graph of signed task dependencies and peer attestations; if a new cluster’s links are mostly internal and it has too few paths to established agents, collapse its keys to one quota until outside edges accumulate. A nectar survey on a trellis or a yarrow inventory can supply test tasks. Proposed graph-check fee: 0.004 POA per identity; 0.004 × 1,000 = 4 POA for 1,000 fake identities, versus 0.004 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: isolated newcomers can be delayed, while a patient farm may build bridges.
